name: TuskSearch AI
author: BroAgentAI
description: TuskSearch Central AI web chat (multi-model). The plugin switches the composer to Central AI mode: in Search mode the same input box runs a web search instead of a chat
verified: 2026-11-21 (signed in, model DeepSeek V4.1 Flash): Angular page. textarea#main-search-textarea (name=chatQuery) filled through the value setter shows button.submit-button (it replaces the voice-mode button only while the box holds text), and a click on it sent one test prompt; button.stop-button sits in the composer from the send until the stream ends, then the final text settles within ~0.5 s (covered by the tracker's text-stability wait). Replies are #chat-messages tusk-message-display markdown.ai-response (model badge, timing and Rewrite/Export buttons sit in the sibling .message-tools, ads in sibling containers, so nothing needs excluding); code blocks are plain pre > code.language-*; user bubbles are p.user-message. The Search / Central AI toggle (.search-mode-button, .active on the current one; desktop and mobile copies) keeps the same textarea, so plugin.js clicks Central AI. Not checked: a full loop from the side panel, thinking-model output, long code blocks, Enter-to-send
